items.summary: Builds on recently launched ICE IDs for private credit instruments Supports instrument identification, research, market discovery, secondary market liquidity and benchmarking Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE: ICE), one of the world's leading providers of financial market technology and data powering global capital markets, today announced the launch of a new reference data service for private credit instruments. The new service builds on the recent launch of ICE IDs, which are the first foundational identifiers for private credit. As the private credit market has scaled, the data infrastructure supporting it has not kept pace, with market participants generally relying upon unstructured, fragmented datasets. ICE’s new reference data service utilizes the firm’s extensive reference data infrastructure and expertise to extract and deliver private credit data directly to clients. ICE Private Credit Reference Data leverages ICE IDs, which are assigned at origination and persist
items.summary_cn: 最近推出的私人信用工具的ICEID支持仪器识别,研究,市场发现,二级市场流动性和基准测量ICE (NYSE:ICE),全球金融市场技术和数据驱动全球资本市场的领先供应商之一,今天宣布推出了私人信贷工具的新参考数据服务.新服务基于最近推出的ICEID,这是私营信贷的首个基本标识符.随着私有信用市场的扩大,支持的数据基础设施并没有保持步伐,市场参与者通常依赖于非结构化,碎片化数据集.ICE的新引用数据服务利用该公司的广泛的参考数据基础架构和专业知识直接提取和交付信用数据.ICES的私营信用数据利用ICES,其来源和身份证据,并将其分配给私人客户.

items.title_cn: 2026年9月28日至10月16日期间将举办的2026年韩国溢价周将在3周内举办.今年首次举办,韩国优惠周2026是韩国金融服务委员会 (FSC) 和韩国交易所 (KRX) 联合组织的最大的资本市场IR活动.共有42家组织,包括资本市相关机构,金融投资公司和媒体机构,以及55家上市公司将参加此次活动.该活动将每年举办并预计将成为韩国资产市场的旗舰 IR活动和全球会议. ▪第1周:核心周 (九月28日,10月2日) 第1周将包括资本和外汇市场的政策会议,以及将韩国上市公司与包括养老基金,投资银行和资产管理者在内的领先全球投资者联系的IR计划. ▪第2周:子周 (68年10月) 第二周将突出增长公司,包括加强KOSDAQ市场的竞争力,KosDAQ和KONEX上市企业的IR项目,以及振兴风险资本退出市场的研讨会. ▪第三周3:子周 (1126年10) 第三周将由私营金融机构组织的一系列活动,包括国内证券公司和资產管理公司,以及全球市场.
items.title_en: Korea Premium Weeks 2026 to be Held from Sept 28 to Oct 16 Korea Premium Weeks 2026 will be held over three weeks, from September 28 to October 16, 2026. First held this year, Korea Premium Weeks 2026 is the largest capital markets IR event in Korea, jointly organized by the Financial Services Commission (FSC) and the Korea Exchange (KRX). A total of 42 organizations, including capital market-related institutions, financial investment firms and media outlets, along with 55 listed companies, will participate in the event. The event will be held annually and is expected to become a flagship IR event and global conference for Koreas capital markets. Under the slogan Gateway to Asias Most Dynamic Capital Market, the event will bring together domestic and international investors to discuss key issues facing Koreas capital markets and explore their future direction. The three-week program will consist of a Core Week in the first week and Sub Weeks in the second and third weeks, with approximately 25 events taking place throughout the period. ▪ Week 1: Core Week (September 28October 2) The first week will feature policy sessions on the capital and foreign exchange markets, as well as IR programs connecting Korean listed companies with leading global investors, including pension funds, investment banks and asset managers. ▪ Week 2: Sub Week (October 68) The second week will highlight growth companies, with a seminar on strengthening the competitiveness of the KOSDAQ market, IR programs for KOSDAQ- and KONEX-listed companies, and a seminar on revitalizing the venture capital exit market. ▪ Week 3: Sub Week (October 1216) The third week will feature a series of events organized by private-sector financial institutions, including domestic securities firms and asset management companies, as well as the global bond market forum For details on the event program and advance registration, please visit the official website for Korea Premium Weeks 2026: http://koreaweeks.com * Please refer to the attached PDF for details.
